brief: Prioritize outstanding work on the asset in descending order of priority, focusing on forced cooling, ventilation, oil levels, and leaks before the heat event begins as outlined in SOP-016. Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure as directed by MG-023. Record every de-rating applied with its reason, value, and period in accordance with MG-021.
